sql.query: SELECT i.id instanceId,i.status instanceStatus,i.guideMode,i.simulatedDateTime,i.currentStepId,p.scenarioCode,p.versionNumber,p.scenarioName,s.stepKey,s.sequenceNumber,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.configurationJson,'$.narrative')) narrative,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_scenario_steps total WHERE total.scenarioPackId=p.id AND total.isActive=1) totalSteps FROM tbl_scenario_instances i INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=i.tenantId AND t.tenantType='demo' INNER JOIN tbl_scenario_packs p ON p.id=i.scenarioPackId INNER JOIN tbl_scenario_steps s ON s.id=i.currentStepId AND s.scenarioPackId=p.id WHERE i.tenantId=:tenantId AND i.status IN ('ready','active','completed') AND t.isActive=1 AND t.lifecycleStatus NOT IN ('closed','suspended') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=i.tenantId AND ut.userId=:userId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 1
